proposed_widenings.name: random_table as OngoingEffect variant
proposed_widenings.justification: Confusion's on-fail effect includes rolling 1d10 at the start of each affected creature's turn to determine behavior. This is a random_table resolution that fires on an on_attached_turn_start trigger. The random_table phase type already exists in ActivationPhase but is absent from the OngoingEffect union, so it cannot be expressed as an ongoing per-turn resolution.
proposed_widenings.evidence: must roll 1d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior for that turn

proposed_widenings.name: restrict_action_economy (or equivalent)
proposed_widenings.justification: The on-fail effect removes the target's ability to take Bonus Actions and Reactions for the duration. No existing EffectAtom covers removal of specific action-economy types from a target. apply_condition cannot express this: Incapacitated removes both the Action and Bonus Action (wrong), and no condition covers 'no Bonus Action + no Reaction' without also blocking the Action. A new atom (e.g., restrict_action_economy with a set of economy types to suppress) is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: that target can't take Bonus Actions or Reactions

notes: The spell is an ongoing_effect (concentration, area, Wis save, repeat save cadence) and structurally matches that family. Two mechanics block honest encoding: (1) the per-turn 1d10 behavior table requires random_table as an OngoingEffect variant — it is currently only an ActivationPhase kind; (2) suppressing Bonus Actions and Reactions (but not Actions) has no EffectAtom equivalent. The repeat-save-to-end pattern (end_of_target_turn, ends_on_target) and the area sphere attachment would both encode cleanly. The radius upcast (+5 ft per slot above 4) would require a surface_widening on AreaShapeDescriptor (no slot-scaling on sphere radius), but that is a secondary gap behind the two primary blockers.
